candidates.title: Liquid Soap
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in personal hygiene retailing once a century-old formula for liquid soap was finally paired with a dispensing pump that made it convenient to sell widely?
candidates.notes: Minnetonka Corporation markets an old product in a new dispenser.

candidates.title: Flash Memory
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a transistor could remember a stored charge even after the power was switched off?
candidates.notes: Masuoka finds a new way to save data.

candidates.title: Hepatitis B Vaccine
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became testable once a rare blood protein pointed researchers to the virus behind a form of hepatitis that could lead to liver cancer?
candidates.notes: Blumberg creates the first anticancer vaccine.

candidates.title: Artificial Skin
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for burn victims once a collagen-based scaffold could serve as a skin substitute when there was not enough of the patient's own skin to graft?
candidates.notes: Burke and Yannas offer hope of renewal for victims of severe burns.

candidates.title: Musical Instrument Digital Interface (MIDI)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for electronic musicians once instruments from different manufacturers could 'talk' to each other through a single shared digital language?
candidates.notes: Smith suggests a common language for all electronic musical instruments.

candidates.title: Personal Computer Modem
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for early computer users once a modem could 'think for itself' and automatically program its own connection to the phone network?
candidates.notes: Hayes simplifies the link between computers and the telephone system.

candidates.title: Reusable Spacecraft
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a spacecraft could glide back to Earth and be reused, instead of every booster rocket being thrown away after a single flight?
candidates.notes: NASA deploys the first Space Shuttle, designed to make multiple trips from Earth.

candidates.title: Scanning Tunneling Microscope
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became visible once a microscope could sense individual atoms by exploiting quantum tunneling rather than using light at all?
candidates.notes: Binnig and Rohrer make it possible to “see” at the atomic level.

candidates.title: Humulin®
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for diabetics once genetically engineered bacteria could produce fully human insulin instead of relying on insulin extracted from cattle and pigs?
candidates.notes: Eli Lilly produces human insulin.

candidates.title: Halogen Cooktop
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible in the kitchen once a heat-resistant glass-ceramic panel let halogen bulbs be used safely as a cooktop?
candidates.notes: Schott creates a heat-resistant cooking surface.

candidates.title: Camcorder
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for filmmakers once a single handheld camcorder replaced the two-person camera-and-recorder rig needed to capture video in the field?
candidates.notes: Sony releases the first handheld video recorder.

candidates.title: Laptop/Notebook Computer
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for computer users once a fully portable machine could be carried like a suitcase and then shrunk further into a true laptop?
candidates.notes: Compaq releases the first commercially successful laptop.

candidates.title: Internet Protocol (TCP/IP)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a layered protocol could let an ever-growing number of independent computer networks connect into a single system?
candidates.notes: Kahn and Cerf enable computers to “talk.”

candidates.title: Stealth Technology
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: Who had to adjust once the U.S. military denied the existence of a radar-evading stealth aircraft for years, until grainy photographs finally confirmed it?
candidates.notes: Lockheed Martin builds an “invisible” plane.

candidates.title: 3D Printing
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once physical objects could be built up layer by layer directly from a computer file instead of being cast or machined?
candidates.notes: A new technology, built up layer by layer.

candidates.title: Self-driving Cars
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in the vision for road safety once vehicles could sense their surroundings and make driving decisions themselves rather than relying on wires or dispatchers in control towers?
candidates.notes: Artificial intelligence learns to drive.

candidates.title: Manned Maneuvering Unit (MMU)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once an astronaut could move freely outside a spacecraft using a powered backpack instead of staying tethered?
candidates.notes: NASA frees astronauts from the tether with a powered individual transporter.

candidates.title: Apple Macintosh
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for ordinary computer users once clicking a mouse on an icon, rather than typing commands, could open a file?
candidates.notes: Apple launches the first successful personal computer with a graphical user interface.

candidates.title: Widget In-can System
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for brewers once a small nitrogen-filled 'widget' inside a can could reproduce the taste and head of draft beer poured from a tap?
candidates.notes: Forage and Byrne replicate in cans the characteristics of draft Guinness.

candidates.title: Automated DNA Sequencer
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for genetics once DNA sequencing could be automated to run 3,000 times faster than reading base pairs by hand?
candidates.notes: Hood and Smith speed up DNA analysis.

candidates.title: Edible Mycoprotein
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in food production once a mold discovered in an English field could be grown at scale as a high-protein meat substitute?
candidates.notes: Rank Hovis McDougall introduces Quorn™.

candidates.title: Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for molecular biology once a single strand of DNA could be copied into unlimited quantities in a test tube?
candidates.notes: Mullis proposes a way to duplicate DNA.

candidates.title: Surgical Robot
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in neurosurgery once a robot, guided by CT imaging, could plot and help execute the path to a lesion inside the skull?
candidates.notes: Kwoh refines robotically assisted surgery.

candidates.title: Bipedal Robot
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for robotics once a machine could balance and walk on two legs instead of only rolling, dragging, or crawling?
candidates.notes: Hitachi creates a successful walking robot.

candidates.title: DNA Fingerprinting
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became governable once a unique genetic pattern could identify a person the way a fingerprint does, first in an immigration dispute and then in criminal prosecutions, despite fears about privacy and DNA databases?
candidates.notes: Jeffreys identifies individuals by their DNA.

candidates.title: Capsule Endoscopy
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became visible inside the digestive tract once a swallowable camera-in-a-capsule could relay images without an invasive endoscope?
candidates.notes: Mullick devises a camera that is swallowed for investigation inside the body.

candidates.title: Driverless Car
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a van fitted with cameras and sensors could navigate ordinary roads at highway speed without a human driver?
candidates.notes: Dickmanns creates a fully automated vehicle.

candidates.title: High-temperature Superconductor
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in physicists' understanding of conductivity once a material was found that could superconduct at temperatures reachable with liquid nitrogen rather than near absolute zero?
candidates.notes: Bednorz and Müller transform conductivity.

candidates.title: Prozac® (Fluoxetine Hydrochloride)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in the treatment of depression once a drug could selectively raise brain serotonin levels rather than relying on older, less targeted antidepressants?
candidates.notes: Eli Lilly revolutionizes the drug treatment of depression.

candidates.title: Palmtop Computer (PDA)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for professionals once a handheld computer could replace the leather-bound paper organizer as the 'must-have' way to track appointments and notes?
candidates.notes: Psion offers the market a handheld computer for personal organization.

candidates.title: Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a silicon chip could combine electronic circuits with tiny mechanical sensors capable of gathering data as well as processing it?
candidates.notes: Silicon chips gain sensory functions.

candidates.title: Massively Multiplayer Online Games
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once hundreds of players could log into a single persistent virtual world together over the Internet rather than a text-only, one-at-a-time game?
candidates.notes: Flinn and Taylor pioneer graphic MMO games.

candidates.title: Statins
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: Who had to adjust once early cholesterol-lowering statin trials were halted over cancer rumors in animal studies, before regulators granted special permission for the drug to reach severely at-risk patients?
candidates.notes: Merck releases a cholesterol-reducing drug.

candidates.title: Tissue Engineering
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible in medicine once cells could be grown on an engineered, biodegradable scaffold to resemble a natural body structure, as vividly shown by a mouse grown with a human-shaped ear on its back?
candidates.notes: Vacanti and Langer grow cell tissue.

candidates.title: Digital Subscriber Line (DSL)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for phone-line Internet access once broadband signals could travel over existing copper telephone wires without blocking the line?
candidates.notes: Lechleider transforms Internet connections.

candidates.title: Intravascular Stent
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for heart patients once a mesh 'scaffold' stent, first modeled from a garage floor find, could hold a blood vessel open after angioplasty?
candidates.notes: Palmaz reopens blocked blood vessels.

candidates.title: Laser Cataract Surgery
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for cataract patients once a laser could break up a clouded lens for removal through a smaller incision?
candidates.notes: Bath devises a laser instrument to facilitate lens removal from the eye.

candidates.title: Touchpad
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for laptop users once a capacitive touchpad could translate a finger's movement into a cursor without a separate mouse?
candidates.notes: Gerpheide finds a replacement for the mouse.

candidates.title: Preimplantation Genetic Diagnosis
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What ethical objections arose once embryos could be tested for genetic disorders before implantation, letting parents choose which fertilized eggs to use rather than risk a pregnancy or remain childless?
candidates.notes: Handyside tests cells for genetic disorders.

candidates.title: MP3 Compression
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in the music industry once MP3 compression made song files small enough to move quickly over the Internet, spawning 'the downloading of music—legal or otherwise'?
candidates.notes: Fraunhofer speeds up music downloading.

candidates.title: DNA Microarray
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became measurable once a glass slide holding hundreds of thousands of DNA strands could reveal which genes were switched on inside a cell?
candidates.notes: Fodor simplifies the study of genetic activity.

candidates.title: World Wide Web
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed once hypertext links and the Internet were combined so that documents anywhere could be connected by a single click?
candidates.notes: Berners-Lee creates the world’s first website.

candidates.title: Gamow Bag®
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for mountaineers and athletes once a portable pressurized bag could simulate lower altitude and treat altitude sickness without a helicopter evacuation?
candidates.notes: Gamow invents a lifesaving sleeping bag.

candidates.title: Sulfur Lamp
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for lighting once ionized sulfur, rather than a tungsten filament, could produce light closer to the sun's natural spectrum?
candidates.notes: Ury and Wood reconsider the light bulb.

candidates.title: Cable Modem
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for home Internet access once the same coaxial cable already carrying television could also deliver high-speed data?
candidates.notes: Yassini connects personal computers to the Internet.

candidates.title: Search Engine
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed once a program could automatically search and index files scattered across the Internet instead of requiring users to know exactly where to look?
candidates.notes: Emtage creates a search tool for the Internet.

candidates.title: Hubble Space Telescope
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became visible about the distant universe once a telescope orbiting above the atmosphere could stare at the same patch of sky for days at a time?
candidates.notes: NASA expands knowledge of the universe.

candidates.title: Webcam
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed once a camera trained on a coffee pot for a university department could be connected to the Internet, letting anyone watch a live image from anywhere?
candidates.notes: Live images join the world of cyberspace.

candidates.title: JPEG Compression
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for the Internet's visual culture once a compression standard let photographic images shrink small enough to be shared and loaded easily online?
candidates.notes: JPEG improves compression of digital images.

candidates.title: Global Positioning System (GPS)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: Who became trackable, and by whom, once satellite positioning built for the military was opened up for commercial and personal navigation, search and rescue, and location tracking in ordinary cell phones?
candidates.notes: The U.S. Defense Dept. updates navigation.

candidates.title: Wind-up Radio
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: Who could finally be reached once a clockwork, battery-free radio was built to bring AIDS-prevention education to parts of Africa without reliable electricity, after investors first turned the idea down?
candidates.notes: Baylis invents the battery-free radio.

candidates.title: Java Computing Language
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for software once a 'write once, run anywhere' language could run the same program on almost any type of computer or device?
candidates.notes: Sun Microsystems boosts the World Wide Web.

candidates.title: USB Connection
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for connecting computer peripherals once a single universal port and plug standard replaced installation cards that machines had to individually learn to recognize?
candidates.notes: USB Implementers Forum provides a standardized interface socket to increase connectivity.

candidates.title: FireWire/IEEE 1394 Connection
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for video and other high-memory devices once a data interface offered speeds far beyond existing USB connections?
candidates.notes: Apple introduces a new digital interface.

candidates.title: Grid Computing
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once idle computers around the world could be loosely joined to provide computing power the way power stations are linked into an electrical grid?
candidates.notes: Computers join together for greater power.

candidates.title: DVD
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for home video once a disc format, agreed by a consortium after a format rivalry, could store far more than a VHS tape or CD?
candidates.notes: A consortium upgrades video recording.

candidates.title: Voice Over Internet Protocol (VoIP)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for long-distance callers once voice could be compressed and sent over an existing Internet connection instead of a costly phone line?
candidates.notes: VocalTec introduces cheap Internet calls.

candidates.title: WLAN Standard
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed once competing, incompatible wireless networking products were brought under one shared standard so any laptop could connect anywhere?
candidates.notes: Hayes regulates wireless networking.

candidates.title: Atom Laser
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once matter could be cooled into a Bose-Einstein condensate stable enough to emit atoms the way a laser emits coherent light?
candidates.notes: Ketterle develops a working atom laser.

candidates.title: Stem Cell Therapy
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What ethical controversy arose once human embryonic stem cells could be isolated and cultured from donated fertility-clinic embryos, and how did reprogramming ordinary skin cells later ease the dispute?
candidates.notes: Thomson and colleagues advance a revolutionary medical therapy.

candidates.title: Viagra® (Sildenafil Citrate)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in public conversation around a private medical condition once a pill for erectile dysfunction led to two million U.S. prescriptions within fourteen weeks of approval?
candidates.notes: Pfizer offers hope for impotent men.

candidates.title: Web Syndication (RSS)
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for news and blogs once a shared feed format let readers gather fast-changing content from many different sites onto one page?
candidates.notes: Guha tracks news on the Web.

candidates.title: Telesurgery
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in the geography of surgical trust once a surgeon in France could remove a patient's gallbladder in real time from thousands of miles away using a robotic system?
candidates.notes: Gagner performs remote surgery with the help of robots.

candidates.title: Artificial Liver
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible in treating liver failure once an artificial system attempted to replicate the liver's many simultaneous chemical functions rather than just pumping blood as an artificial heart does?
candidates.notes: Matsumura invents a potential lifesaver for patients with acute liver failure.

candidates.title: Segway PT
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What happened to public expectations once a scooter rumored to be 'maybe bigger than the Internet' turned out, on unveiling, to be an expensive gyroscopic device that struggled to escape its geeky stigma?
candidates.notes: Kamen produces a gyroscopic scooter.

candidates.title: Satellite Radio Broadcasting
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for radio listeners once a subscription satellite service could deliver a hundred uninterrupted channels regardless of distance from a local transmitter?
candidates.notes: XM revolutionizes radio broadcasting.

candidates.title: Optical Camouflage
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a coat covered in reflective beads could project its background onto itself, rendering a wearer nearly invisible?
candidates.notes: Tachi creates a see-through coat.

candidates.title: Laser Track and Trace System
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became trackable once a laser-etched barcode could be tattooed directly onto a piece of produce, recording its variety, origin, and pick date without a sticker?
candidates.notes: Drouillard traces product movements.

candidates.title: Scramjet
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for high-speed flight once an engine could burn fuel using oxygen drawn from the atmosphere instead of carrying its own oxidant?
candidates.notes: The University of Queensland and QinetiQ develop hypersonic travel.

candidates.title: Blu-ray/HD DVD
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for high-definition video once a shorter-wavelength laser allowed a disc to store six times more data than a standard DVD?
candidates.notes: Nakamura optimizes optical storage.

candidates.title: Podcast
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for audio and video distribution once a file could be automatically delivered to subscribers' devices through an RSS feed instead of requiring them to seek it out?
candidates.notes: Lydon and Winer pioneer digital media files.

candidates.title: High-density Computer Storage
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for data storage once nanotechnology allowed information to be written and read from tiny depressions on a polymer surface?
candidates.notes: IBM boosts computer memory dramatically.

candidates.title: Color Night Vision
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became easier to judge at night once night-vision systems could render a scene in a range of colors instead of the traditional gray or green?
candidates.notes: TNO refines the technology of night vision.

candidates.title: Surface Computing
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in how people interacted with computers once a table itself, rather than a screen and keyboard, could recognize objects placed on it and respond to touch?
candidates.notes: Microsoft takes the personal computer off the table—to become the table itself.

candidates.title: Printing On Demand
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for publishers once a book could be printed only after a customer ordered it, keeping obscure or older titles from going out of print?
candidates.notes: Books on Demand cuts short-run print costs.

candidates.title: iPhone
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in daily life once a single touch-screen device could combine a phone, a music player, a camera, and Internet browsing, despite early criticism of its price?
candidates.notes: Apple adds capabilities to the cell phone.

candidates.title: Graphene Transistor
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for computing once a single-atom-thick sheet of carbon showed potential to make transistors far faster than silicon?
candidates.notes: IBM researchers improve transistors made from single-atom-thick sheets of carbon.

candidates.title: Cloud Computing
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for individuals and small businesses once they could 'rent' remote servers and software over the Internet instead of owning local hardware?
candidates.notes: Web 2.0 enables shared computing resources.

candidates.title: Synthetic Genome
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed in the definition of life once a bacterial genome could be entirely designed on a computer, synthesized in a lab, and transplanted to create a self-replicating cell with no natural DNA?
candidates.notes: The first synthetic organism is created.

candidates.title: Tablet Computer
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a device between a smartphone and a laptop finally combined low weight, long battery life, and an affordable price to define a new category of computer?
candidates.notes: Apple pioneers a new genre of computer.

candidates.title: Intelligent Personal Assistant
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What changed for everyday tasks once a voice-activated assistant could combine personal information and Internet data to book, cancel, and organize on a user's behalf?
candidates.notes: Apple develops a computerized secretary.

candidates.title: CRISPR Gene Editing
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What moral and ethical questions arose once the CRISPR-Cas9 system let scientists edit an organism's genome to order, including the prospect of making inheritable changes to human embryos?
candidates.notes: A revolution in medical science.

candidates.title: Mind-Controlled Prosthetic
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible for amputees once implanted sensors could let a prosthetic leg respond to a wearer's own subconscious muscle signals?
candidates.notes: Ossur unveils a bionic leg that can be controlled by subconscious intentions.

candidates.title: Artificial Womb
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What might change in the survival and experience of extremely premature infants once a fluid-filled artificial womb, tested successfully on lambs, offered an alternative to ventilators and incubators?
candidates.notes: A viable alternative to the female uterus.

candidates.title: Simultaneous Machine Translation
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a wearable earpiece could translate spoken conversation between two languages in near real time?
candidates.notes: Eliminating language barriers with an app.

candidates.title: Jet Pack
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became possible once a jet-engine-powered pack could sustain longer, more controlled personal flight than earlier rocket-propelled attempts?
candidates.notes: Gravity Industries makes a science fiction dream come true.

candidates.title: Quantum Computer
candidates.possibleSocialAdjustmentQuestion: What became thinkable in computing once a qubit could hold the value of 1 and 0 simultaneously, making some tasks trivial that would take conventional computers millions of years?
candidates.notes: IBM points to a stable quantum future.
